profile.headline: Sr . Software Engineer at  EnlivenHealth
profile.summary:
I am an IT professional with over 10 years of experience in software analysis, design, development, and testing for client-server and web applications. My expertise spans both manual and automated testing, utilizing tools such as Selenium IDE and WebDriver within hybrid frameworks, and leveraging TestNG for detailed reporting.

I have a solid foundation in programming languages like Java, C, and SQL, along with practical knowledge of web services testing using SOAP UI. My experience includes developing testing frameworks using the Page Object Model design pattern and creating comprehensive test strategies and documentation for User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

Well-versed in various domains, including insurance and healthcare, I am familiar with all phases of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC). I have hands-on experience with tools like HP Quality Center, JIRA, API and Datadog, as well as proficiency in operating systems like Windows, UNIX, and Linux.

Driven by a commitment to quality and continuous improvement, I thrive in collaborative environments where I can contribute my skills to deliver effective software solutions.

positions.title: Senior Test Analyst
positions.description:
Description:
The Performance Test Analyst ensures the performance of MetLife application and infrastructure changes.  The Performance Test Group is responsible for managing the performance testing of medium to large projects to ensure delivered code or infrastructure changes meet defined acceptance criteria

Responsibilities: 
•	Provide guidance to a team of offshore/near-shore analysts on performance testing efforts.
•	Provide performance test consulting on efforts as required.
•	Responsible for ensuring performance test estimation, planning, automation, and status reporting are properly executed for assigned teams.
•	Validate the work of assigned team to ensure properly designed use cases, test cases, performance test case automation, and application of appropriate and efficient performance test analysis, design, and coverage. 
•	Analyze and make recommendations based on performance test operational metrics.
•	Partner with functional test teams to create an integrated test experience for MetLife business partners. 
•	Performance defect and root cause analysis.
•	Participate in the evaluation of new performance test tools like QC.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · Regression Testing · Selenium · Test Planning · Software Quality Assurance · Healthcare Industry

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Description:

Ateb focuses on providing communication solutions to allow patients to communicate with the pharmacy in a way that is most convenient, comfortable, and preferable to the patient. In addition, Ateb provides workflow solutions to improve filling accuracy and increase efficiencies so the pharmacy team spends less time on manual tasks and more time serving the patient. 

•	Develop a solution for pharmacies called IVR (Interactive Voice Response) solution.
•	Implement all lower level script and library files in Embedded C .
•	Developing a user interface in Core JAVA, Structs , EJB and  Spring .
•	Responsible for developing a Front End using  Web Services : HTML , XML and SOAP 
•	Also work on JSP to create JSP pages for internet solution   .
•	Also work on some JAVA based simulator for example TechRx , Meckesson etc.
•	Worked with J2EE design patterns in based on MVC architecture.
•	Using SVN for version control.
•	Using Client WSDL file and based on that create a service.
•	Good knowledge of different kinds of  phone  system like Analog  and Digital phone and also know how can configure different phone line like T1 , PRI , SIP  . 

Environment: JAVA , JSP, SQL, Eclipse, Apache Tomcat ,WebLogic12c, C, XML , Java Script, SOAP ,Unix , HTML, Spring , Struts ,Linux , Window , SCO

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Description:

Avant focuses on all Diamond related solution , this company make a solution to measuring  a diamond. How much diamond need to cut and after all provide a good shape .

Responsibilities: 

•	Performing a Software Testing to verify the Diamond Cutting equipment was working properly or not.
•	Performing Testing according to stringent requirements of measurement and cutting accuracy.
•	Developing this solution using programming language C++ .
•	Operating system they are using Unix and Linux .

Environment: C++ , Linux , UNIX

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Description:

Bhabha Atomic Research Centre offers creative and rewarding career opportunities to young qualified men and women who like challenges in frontline areas of Nuclear Science and Technology and are keen to be a part of expanding Indian nuclear power programme. Ample prospects are available for pursuing innovative research in Engineering, Physics, Chemistry, Biosciences, Geology, or Geophysics, Engineering and Biosciences at different R&D centres under the Department of Atomic.

Responsibilities: 

•	Develop a solution using EigenFace methodology to perform Face reorganization stems functionality. 
•	Develop Integration software to integrate the Face Reorganization with Smart Card Application. 
•	Develop Software to perform data analysis against the database to implement a level of security Block against unauthorized users.
•	 Perform preliminary testing of the Software to ensure proper functionality for Information Security, Commercial security and Access Control Environments. 
•	Software was built in MATLAB and C.

Environment: C , Linux , UNIX, MATLAB
